reviews.comment: 4th build, second time in this case. I would say good but slightly flimsy. The bottom has a socket for extra cable management. Fits on my desk perfectly.
reviews.author: Rosa

reviews.title: Good looking inexpensive case
reviews.comment:
Inexpensive but looks pretty good. The glass panel was pretty hard to get off and I feared I might break it ..also not knowing how the glass was attached didn't help either, but it slides back, no magnets
I'll have to rebuild my wife's setup and really work on my cable management. I've never worked with this type of case design before .. but now I know, lol
the front 4 fans are reverse fans I had from my wife and daughter's previous cases. It seems like the air flow is pretty good to keep the components cool.
Spacious but harder to hide your cables in the front
Case seems pretty sturdy and the noise level is pretty low. I have all the fans set to performance and the 3 fans on the AIO or currently plugged straight into the power supply so they are running full boar...
Coming from a Montech X3 Mesh case that is also a great budget case if you have smaller sized GPU.

HYXN H3 case
ASRock PG27QRT1B 1440p primary monitor/22" 1080p 75hz secondary
Windows 11 Pro
